documentation: The source digest of the Cinder token base each published @lostgradient/cinder version ships, keyed by version: `computeSourceDigest` over the published package's `src/tokens/cinder.resolver.json` and the nine token documents the runtime bundles. The Playground stamps `published-versions.json`'s Cinder version into its bundled token runtime only when the bundled base has that version's digest; otherwise the runtime keeps the `workspace` sentinel, because the source is unreleased (COR-231). Add an entry, from the registry tarball, whenever the Cinder version in `published-versions.json` changes: `cinder-package-version-plugin.test.ts` fails while `lastPublishedVersion` has none. 0.27.1 predates the token runtime but ships the documents; 0.28.0 was the first release with the runtime.
